inputs.job_description:
Introduction
VAARHAFT is a young startup that deals with the authentication of digital media. In an age of publicly accessible generative AI, creating deepfakes has become child's play, meaning that the authenticity of digital images and videos can no longer be blindly trusted.
Our mission is to preserve the credibility of digital media and protect companies from fraud involving manipulated images, videos, or documents with our solutions. We are active in all industries where the credibility of digital images is essential. Among other things, we prevent image-based insurance fraud and uncover document forgeries in the banking sector.
Tasks
As a working student in Customer Success, you will be the right hand of our Customer Success Managers. You will accompany our customers on their journey with our product and ensure that everything runs smoothly in the background. You will learn how to build long-term customer relationships and lead projects to success.
Preparation and follow-up: You will create presentation materials for onboarding and review meetings. After the meetings, you will summarize the results and enter the next steps into our system.
First-line support: You will be the first point of contact for written customer inquiries and will respond to them confidently or forward them to the appropriate internal departments.
Project tracking: You will keep a close eye on our customer projects and monitor progress and important milestones.
Health score check: You will analyze customer use of our software and proactively identify areas where we can provide support.
Performing batch analyses: You organize and accompany our batch analyses and evaluate them in a meaningful and professional manner.
Content creation: You assist in the creation of help articles or best practice guides for our customers.
Requirements
You are currently enrolled in a degree program in business administration, communication, business informatics, or a comparable field at a university or technical college for at least one more year and are available for 20 hours per week.
You love structure and don't lose track of things even when working on many projects at the same time.
You are confident in your written and spoken communication skills (German & English) and are not afraid of direct customer contact.
You see where work needs to be done and like to think one step ahead.
You enjoy working in a team and communicate openly and transparently.
Benefits
Insights into a young startup where you can actively contribute
New challenges with a steep learning curve in a motivated team and a fast-paced work environment
Flat hierarchies and individual talent development
Real startup life in our co-working spaces in the cities of Hamburg and Berlin, as well as flexible working hours and the option to work remotely up to 100% of the time
Regular team-building events
At VAARHAFT, we value diversity and equal opportunity. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, beliefs, disability, age, or sexual identity. It is important to us to create an inclusive and non-discriminatory work environment where everyone can fully develop their talents.

Introduction
Based in Berlin, the idea for Carovo was born in 2022. Our mission is to enable the future of e-mobility in Europe by building the leading European marketplace for used EVs. We are making buying and selling used electric vehicles as easy as a walk in the park and redefine what transparency means in this market. Our online end-to-end platform product is already fascinating our customers and partners with its leading user-friendliness.
Tasks
Act as primary support to the CEO in developing the supply side & demand side of our marketplace.
Strategize with the CEO on our market approach and customer engagement and execute go-to-market efforts.
Contribute to shaping the company’s long-term strategic vision, collaborating closely with the C-level to identify new growth and innovation opportunities across all business aspects.
Assist with operational tasks and provide flexible support across the company, tackling a variety of tasks and urgent projects as needed, adapting quickly to evolving priorities.
Prepare for upcoming fundraising rounds and maintain investor relations.
Assist in maintaining relationships with key partners at the C-level.
Gather customer feedback on our products and perform product demonstrations.
Work on expanding Carovo in the areas of Business Development and Product.
Requirements
Completed or currently enrolled in business administration, management or a comparable course of study
Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken

Immerse yourself in our vibrant office in Berlin, with flexible hybrid work options.
Work in a team with diverse backgrounds and experiences, valuing diversity as a key to success.
Open communication and a drive for excellence, fostering both personal and professional growth.

While experience is important, we focus more on finding passionate individuals eager to learn and grow with us. If you're excited about shaping the future of e-mobility, we'd love to hear from you.

Über uns
Die Mansour-Initiative für Demokratieförderung und Extremismusprävention - MIND prevention - gGmbH wurde 2017 durch Ahmad und Beatrice Mansour gegründet.
Prävention von Extremismus und Antisemitismus sowie der Einsatz für Gleichberechtigung stehen im Zentrum unserer Arbeit. Entsprechend unserem Leitmotiv "Freiheit beginnt im Kopf" entwickeln und realisieren wir Workshops, Fortbildungen und digitale Konzepte, in denen bzw. mit denen geübt und gelernt werden kann, den eigenen Standpunkt zu hinterfragen und kritisch zu denken. Wir glauben an ein gleichberechtigtes Miteinander und daran, dass Begegnung und Austausch die Schlüssel für eine zukunftsfähige Gesellschaft sind. Als Team kämpfen wir für Freiheit und Selbstbestimmung. Für unsere Demokratie.
Beschreibung
Unser neuestes Projekt RESPONSE hat die Prävention islamistischer Radikalisierung Jugendlicher und junger Erwachsener zum Ziel. Es umfasst Präventionsworkshops für Jugendliche, Fortbildungen für pädagogische und psychosoziale Fachkräfte sowie ein digitales Monitoring in Form der Analyse (sozialer) Medien und Entwicklung von Counter-Narratives. Darüber hinaus entwickeln wir parallel dazu ein theoriegeleitetes Evaluations- und Forschungsdesign, um die Workshops und Fortbildungen wissenschaftlich zu untermauern.
Ab dem nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt (vorbehaltlich Projektgenehmigung) suchen wir Dich als…
Wissenschaftliche Hilfskraft (m/w/d)
…zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet, in Teilzeit (20 Stunden/Woche), Vergütung orientiert sich am TVöD Bund 2025/2026, Eingruppierung E6, Einstufung je nach Berufserfahrung
Deine Aufgaben
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem wissenschaftlichen Team von RESPONSE sowie Mitarbeit an der Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung und technischer Umsetzung
Unterstützung bei der Durchführung von Recherche-, Forschungs- und Analyseaufgaben

inputs.job_description:
Introduction
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND
The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.
Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we’re the world’s first certified climate neutral TV streaming provider. Several million users across three countries. Over 230 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one. That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.
Zattoo is the leading player in the TV-as-a-Service space in Europe serving several million TV users and dozens of B2B customers, helping them watch what they want, where they want, when they want. As our user and subscriber base is constantly growing we are searching for a highly motivated Customer Service Specialist who is passionate about helping customers and excited about how new technologies and AI can improve the way we support our users.
CONSUMER TEAM @ZATTOO
Customer Service is part of the Consumer Team at Zattoo. The Consumer Team focuses on shaping the overall experience of our users across the entire customer journey - from discovering Zattoo to using and enjoying our product every day.
The team combines expertise from areas such as Product, Marketing, Data and Customer Service to better understand user needs, identify opportunities for improvement and continuously enhance the Zattoo experience. By leveraging customer insights, data and modern technologies, the Consumer Team plays a key role in ensuring that our product remains intuitive, reliable and truly customer-focused for millions of users.
Customer feedback and real user interactions are at the heart of this work, making Customer Service an important bridge between our users and internal teams.
Your tasks
THE ROLE
You will be part of a skilled Customer Service team and play an important role in responding to user inquiries while also contributing to the evolution of our support operations through modern tools, automation and AI-driven solutions.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Support our Customer Service team in delivering excellent support to our Zattoo users while helping us evolve our service operations with modern AI and automation tools.
Customer Support
Respond to inbound customer inquiries using our customer service tools (email and chat) and process subscription refunds when required
Answer questions and comments on our social media channels and through the app stores
Identify trends in recurring customer inquiries and proactively suggest improvements for our service and product
Escalate issues reported by Zattoo users internally and help detect patterns across support cases
Customer Service Tools & CRM
Maintain and update data in our customer service tools and CRM systems
Support the administration and optimization of customer support tools and workflows
Help evaluate and implement new features within our support platforms
AI & Automation in Customer Support
Support the development and improvement of AI-driven customer support solutions (e.g. chatbots, AI assistants, agentic AI workflows)
Help test, train and optimize AI systems used in customer service
Identify opportunities where automation or AI could improve support processes while maintaining a high-quality, human-centered customer experience
WHAT YOU’LL BRING
Fluency in English is required, German is beneficial
Experience responding to emails, App Store reviews or social media queries for a large user base
Strong digital affinity and curiosity for new technologies
Interest in AI tools, automation and modern customer support technologies
Familiarity with CRM systems, support platforms or workflow tools (e.g. Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, etc.)
Structured and analytical thinking with the ability to identify patterns in user feedback
Excellent communication skills and a strong customer-first mindset
Comfortable working with remote colleagues and cross-functional teams
We offer
WHY JOIN US?
At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.
WHAT WE OFFER YOU
Reward
: Strong market competitive salary
Invest:
Valuable work experience, guidance, and growth opportunities
Regulate
: Trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year
Plus:
We’resharing:
Free access to the best streaming experience on the market
We're developing:
Access to exciting learning opportunities like internal trainings, German language classes and hackdays
**We’re inclusive: ‘**Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
We’re healthy:
Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
We’re responsible:
We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team,
We’re sociable:
A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event
Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer, join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to the future of TV.

About commercetools
Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.
Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.
At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.
Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.
Your tasks
Your Impact
As a working student you will support the Workplace Experience team in ensuring a positive and well-organized workplace experience in the Berlin office, while assisting with selected global workplace initiatives.
The role provides hands-on operational support for daily office needs and helps create a welcoming, safe, and productive environment for employees.
You will:
Implement global workplace experience standards and programs in the Berlin office, under guidance from the Lead.
Assist with day-to-day office operations, including facilities coordination and support with vendors (cleaning, security, catering, maintenance).
Help with administrative tasks related to workplace tools and services, such as travel coordination or external vendors.
Support the upkeep of the office environment to ensure it is welcoming, functional, and aligned with workplace guidelines.
Act as a first point of contact for basic workplace-related questions from employees and escalates topics when needed.
Assist in organizing local events, employee engagement activities, and internal meetings.
Help manage office supplies, equipment, and inventory.
Support onboarding and offboarding activities from a workplace perspective.
Assist with health and safety documentation and compliance tasks, under supervision.
Share observations and feedback with the Lead regarding employee experience and office operations.
What you need to succeed:
Enrolled as a student (working student status required).
Fluent in German - Native speaker / German language certificate: C1
Fliuent in English - Native speaker / English language certificate: C1
Initial experience or strong interest in workplace experience, office management, hospitality, or people-focused services.
A proactive, hands-on, and service-oriented mindset.
Good communication skills and a friendly, professional approach when interacting with employees and vendors.
Ability to stay organized, manage multiple tasks, and work independently with guidance.
Interest in creating a positive, inclusive, and engaging workplace environment.
Nice to have:
Some experience working in a fast-paced environment, e.g., a startup, student project, or part-time job.
Basic familiarity with workplace programs, employee engagement, or hospitality services.
Interest in supporting daily office operations and working in a hybrid work environment.
Enthusiasm for helping build community, organizing events, and supporting employee well-being initiatives.
Strong communication and teamwork skills
Our Benefits
Please note for this role, the successful candidate will be required to be onsite at our Berlin office Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday.
Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.
For more information on our benefits, visit this page.
Come as you are. Build with us.
Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.
We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community.
